cues: HIV is a retrovirus: two strands of RNA and its own enzymes inside an envelope.
It targets the helper T lymphocyte, the cell that coordinates the whole immune response.
It binds the C D four receptor, copies its RNA into DNA with reverse transcriptase, splices that DNA into our own chromosome with integrase, and turns the cell into a virus factory until it dies.
